title: vocab-kb: controlled vocabulary stores
description: Schema for tools/subject/core/vocab/cah.json (formerly vocab-kb/cah.json; moved under TLS-1, HMD-1, adp-0204) (HESA Common Aggregation Hierarchy, landed Prompt 67, 18 Sep 2026, completed under HSV-1, 26 Sep 2026). A vocab-kb store is a flat code+label vocabulary that other stores' subjectClassification fields (common.schema.json) match against by code. This schema fixes the CAH shape specifically: a source header recording provenance, plus three code arrays (cah1/cah2/cah3) each holding one CAH level, a placeholders array for non-selectable rows such as CAHZ5, and a previousSource header preserving the store's prior provenance once superseded. Row shapes are inlined rather than local $defs+$ref (house convention: schemas in this directory only $ref into common.schema.json, never into themselves, because this file's own absolute $id makes a same-document $ref resolve as a network fetch rather than a local lookup offline).

source.description: Provenance for the vocabulary as a whole: issuer, the vocabulary's own version, its licence, where and how it was retrieved, and the source files it was built from.

vocabulary.description: Name of the vocabulary, e.g. Common Aggregation Hierarchy (CAH).

version.description: The vocabulary's own version/edition, as published, e.g. 1.3.4.

url.description: Where the file was retrieved from. Not necessarily the issuer's own domain (F9 pointer discipline; a mirror is acceptable if provenance is recorded).

licence.description: The vocabulary's own licence, if HESA states one for it.

value.description: The licence identifier, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, or null if HESA states none.

url.description: The page stating the licence (or its absence), or null.

note.description: Free-text explaining the licence value, e.g. that HESA's page states none.

provenance.description: How this copy reached the repo, e.g. supplied by Abbott, downloaded from HESA.

files.description: The source CSV(s) this store was built from: name, content hash, and data-row count, so a re-run can be checked for drift.

name.description: The source file's own name, e.g. CAH_Groupings.csv.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes with a trailing newline stripped.

note.description: Free-text provenance detail, e.g. why a mirror was used, cross-checks performed.

previousSource.description: The store's prior source header, kept once superseded rather than deleted (HSV-1). Carries the same shape the source header had before, plus supersededBy naming the ruling that replaced it.

supersededBy.description: The id of the ruling that superseded this source, e.g. HSV-1.

cah1.description: CAH1 broad subject groups. Top of the hierarchy; no parent.

items.description: A CAH1 row: code and label only, no parent.

cah2.description: CAH2 disciplines. Each carries a parent resolving to a cah1 code.

items.description: A CAH2 row: code, label, and the parent CAH1 code.

label.description: Display label, e.g. sociology, social policy and anthropology.

parent.description: CAH1 code this row sits under. Structural-invariant checked (resolves to an existing cah1 row), not enforceable by JSON Schema alone.

cah3.description: CAH3 subjects. Each carries a parent resolving to a cah2 code. Complete since HSV-1 (26 Sep 2026): every CAH3 code HESA's groupings data names, superseding the partial landing recorded in cah3Note (Prompt 67, DL-1 SHAPE RESOLUTION).

items.description: A CAH3 row: code, label, and the parent CAH2 code.

parent.description: CAH2 code this row sits under. Structural-invariant checked (resolves to an existing cah2 row), not enforceable by JSON Schema alone.

placeholders.description: Non-selectable rows recorded apart from cah1/cah2/cah3 so the level counts stay the real ones, e.g. CAHZ5 'Not applicable'.

levels.description: Which level array(s) this code would otherwise have appeared in.

selectable.description: Always false: a placeholder is never offered as a choice.

cah3Note.description: Historical note explaining cah3's former partial coverage (Prompt 67, DL-1 SHAPE RESOLUTION) and any per-discipline absences. Kept verbatim once superseded; see cah3NoteSuperseded.

cah3NoteSuperseded.description: Marks cah3Note as superseded without deleting it.

by.description: The id of the ruling that superseded cah3Note, e.g. HSV-1.
